SINGAPORE FREELANCER TAX SET-ASIDE · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

Enter your business income and expenses. You get income tax after earned income relief, a MediSave flag, and the share of every invoice to put away.

Written from the published IRAS resident rates (unchanged since Year of Assessment 2024) for income earned in 2026, assessed in YA 2027, without a live lookup. IRAS decides. Not tax advice.

Enter your income, then click Calculate.

What it does, and what it leaves to you

    
    
      
  • Covers: the resident income tax bands from 0% to 24%, earned income relief by age, a total for any other reliefs you enter (capped at S$80,000), and flags for MediSave, Form B filing and GST registration.
    • 
      
  • Not decided: non-residents, MediSave amounts, spouse and child reliefs, other income, partnership shares, trade losses, GST amounts, and how IRAS treats a particular expense. IRAS or your accountant decide these.
    • 
    

  


  

    
Common questions

    
How much of my freelance income should I set aside for tax in Singapore?

    
It depends on profit: the first S$20,000 of chargeable income is untaxed and rates climb from 2% to 24%, so a freelancer on S$90,000 profit sets aside roughly 5% of profit while one on S$250,000 sets aside far more. Enter your income and expenses for a number built from the actual IRAS bands.

    
Is there provisional tax in Singapore?

    
No. IRAS taxes income earned in a calendar year in the next Year of Assessment: file Form B by 18 April, receive a Notice of Assessment, then usually pay by GIRO instalments over up to 12 months. Keep the money aside until then.

    
Do freelancers pay CPF?

    
Self-employed people do not have to make CPF Ordinary Account contributions, but those with net trade income above S$6,000 must contribute to MediSave. This tool flags it but does not calculate it.

    
When must I register for GST?

    
When taxable turnover exceeds S$1 million in a calendar year or is expected to in the next 12 months. GST you collect belongs to IRAS, so keep it out of your set-aside.

    
Is my data uploaded anywhere?

    
No. Everything is calculated in your browser and nothing is sent.

Your answers. This page runs in your browser and sends nothing anywhere; closing the tab discards them, and downloads are files on your own device.

    
Best-effort hosting, no SLA. These tools are free, experimental, and may be slow, broken, moved, or taken offline without notice. We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record: nothing you enter is saved anywhere.

    
Everything runs in your browser. Your answers are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (analysis_run, example_loaded, summary_downloaded) are counted only in local storage on your device, never with any of your data, and are switched off by Do Not Track.
